summary: Master cash flow forecasting and liquidity risk management with our comprehensive training. Equip yourself with essential skills for financial success.
lede: Cash flow forecasting and liquidity risk management help finance and treasury professionals estimate cash needs and respond to funding gaps. Participants build rolling forecasts, map cash drivers, test scenarios, interpret liquidity measures, and design contingency funding plans using Excel-based models. They also practice variance analysis and dashboard-style reporting to explain liquidity headroom and funding actions to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who already work with cash, funding, and liquidity data and need a more rigorous operating method. It suits people who must forecast cash accurately, explain liquidity pressure, and support funding decisions with credible evidence.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of corporate finance, cash flow statements, and basic spreadsheet analysis. Familiarity with treasury processes, working capital concepts, and financial reporting will help you move faster, but no programming is required. Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed, and they should be prepared to work with forecast templates, cash flow schedules, and variance analysis exercises. Experience with budgeting or FP&A workflows is helpful, especially if you already support funding, treasury, or liquidity reporting.
